text:
**4,000 mg is the absolute adult ceiling, but the Tylenol label caps lower, and 3,000 mg/day is the safer practical limit.**

- Extra Strength (500 mg): max 6 tablets (3,000 mg) per 24 hours.
- Regular Strength (325 mg): max 10 tablets (3,250 mg) per 24 hours.

Stay at or under 3,000 mg if you drink alcohol regularly, have liver disease, are underweight, or are malnourished. Count acetaminophen from other products too (NyQuil, Excedrin, many prescription opioid combinations). Overdose can cause liver damage with few early symptoms, so call poison control (1-800-222-1222 in the US) if you exceed the limit.
